perceptual_screen.method: 32x32 luminance LANCZOS, orthonormal 2D DCT; top-left 8x8 excluding DC; median threshold; cross-group Hamming distance <= 4 of 63 bits
perceptual_screen.limitation: Heuristic candidate screen only. A negative screen does not establish absence of semantic, event or burst dependence. No images were removed or substituted.
